# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 15 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 15:1 — The Lord will make you live vs. give you life

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "The Lord will make you live" | Literal zōopoiēsei se |
| LOGOS | "The Lord will give you life" | Standard idiomatic English |
| PNEUMA | "The Lord will give you life" | Same as LOGOS |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** LOGOS and PNEUMA agree: 'give you life.' This is more natural in English and captures the causative sense of zōopoiēsei. Adopted LOGOS.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 15:4 — Joseph's prayer — parallel to 4:9

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "who made everything alive and called the darkness to the light" | Follows parallel of ch.4 |
| LOGOS | "who gives life to all things and calls from darkness to light" | Tightened; matches ch.4 wording |
| PNEUMA | "you give life to all things, you call people from darkness to light" | Splits into two clauses |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** LOGOS maintains verbal parallelism with Joseph's earlier prayer (ch.4), which is intentional. Adopted LOGOS for consistency.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---
